items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: I said something about Doc Suchon.

ctx.x: I don't believe it. I heard that from Thomas Berry. I heard that from Thomas Berry. I said something about Doc Suchon. No, yellow wasn't. The other thing's going.

I don't believe it about Sidney Allen. Is he living in Sidney? No, but I'm the white as Sidney Allen. Well, I understand when he first wrote Lazy Ripper, he called it Lazy Lazy Nigger. That was the first thing we heard of him, huh?
